enabled_authority_kinds.brain_item_version: Exact current or disputed canonical Brain item version, scoped to workspace owner, subject, audience and prepared-intelligence purpose. Superseded, expired and prohibited-in-context versions fail closed.
enabled_authority_kinds.external_source_receipt: Exact external Brain source with matching scope, prepared-intelligence purpose, integrity digest, locator and active retention.

closed_authority_kinds.decision_case_snapshot: Legacy decision rows do not yet provide canonical Brain workspace binding and immutable snapshot authority.
closed_authority_kinds.decision_claim_snapshot: Legacy decision rows do not yet provide canonical Brain workspace binding and immutable snapshot authority.

negative_controls: removing the item consequence-permission predicate makes the canary fail
removing the source retention predicate makes the canary fail
removing the item workspace predicate makes the canary fail

interpretive_boundary.disputed_is_not_truth: A disputed item may be current enough to disclose as context, but its standing is included in the digest and must remain visible downstream. Currentness is not endorsement.
interpretive_boundary.external_purpose_is_strict: Legacy external sources without the exact prepared_intelligence purpose remain unavailable until deliberately remapped. No broad compatibility fallback exists.
interpretive_boundary.returned_metadata_only: The adapter returns version, digest, recorded time and exact scope. It does not return source or item content.

remaining_gates: Add atomic correction invalidation so changed authority cannot leave an apparently current prepared receipt.
Add cryptographic erasure plus a subject tombstone that prevents silent revival.
Define workspace-bound immutable authority for decision cases and claims before enabling them.
Prove concurrent replay convergence on a multi-connection PostgreSQL runtime.
Run candidates and tests through Supabase local plus PostgREST when Docker or Podman is available.
Review any migration and runtime caller separately before application.
bounded_claim: R11 proves fail-closed current-authority adapters for canonical Brain item versions and external source receipts on a disposable PostgreSQL 18.3 fixture shaped after the production tables. It does not prove the full migration graph, Supabase/PostgREST parity, decision authority, correction, erasure, concurrency, migration or production readiness.
